nodes.title: H3 Upscale Options
widgets_values:
upscale_factor: float 1..10 = 2   # How much the H3 Latent Upscaler 3D enlarges the video (2 = twice the width and height).
refine_amount: float 0..1 = 0.2   # How much of the upscaled video is generated again (the refine's denoise). Low keeps it close to the upscale; higher adds more new detail but can change faces and motion.

nodes.title: H3 Generation Engine Settings
widgets_values:
attention: choice pytorch, sage, comfy_kitchen = pytorch   # The attention backend. pytorch: ComfyUI's default. sage: SageAttention through KJNodes (needs the sageattention package). comfy_kitchen: ComfyUI's comfy-kitchen kernels.
sparse_attention: choice none, vsa   # vsa: block-sparse attention (the core Model Sparse Attention node, set up inside H3 Model Optimization). Faster on long or large videos, at some cost in detail. none: full attention.
spectrum: bool = false   # Spectrum (xmarre's pack): forecasts part of the model's work on some steps instead of computing it. Faster, at a small cost in quality.
turbo_loader: choice off, normal, larryvrh = off   # How a turbo (few-step) LoRA is applied. off: no turbo LoRA. normal: ComfyUI's LoRA loader, for LoRAs such as LightX2V. larryvrh: Larryvrh's MiniMax-H3 Turbo loader, for its own turbo LoRA.
turbo_lora: @LoraName (obvpm).lora_name when turbo_loader != off   # The turbo LoRA file. It must suit the loader chosen above.
turbo_strength: float 0..1.00 = 1.0 when turbo_loader != off   # The turbo LoRA's strength. 1.0 is as trained.
steps: int = 20   # Sampling steps. With a turbo LoRA, the step count it was made for; without one, about 20.
sampler: @SamplerName (obvpm).sampler_name = euler   # The sampler.
scheduler: @SchedulerName (obvpm).scheduler = beta   # The noise schedule.
shift_video: int = 12   # Sigma shift for the video. Higher spends more of the steps at high noise (composition and motion), lower more on fine detail.
shift_audio: int = 3   # Sigma shift for the audio, like shift_video.

properties.compatible_message: Please consider supporting me on Patreon! You'll get access to workflow updates, fixes, and new features before others. Exclusive workflows, and also join our Supporters Discord!

widgets_values:
comfyui >= 0.35.0
comfyui-obvpm >= 0.2.9   https://github.com/chanon/comfyui-obvpm   # Bundle and Unbundle set and get bundles by name
comfyui-obvpm-timeline >= 0.1.1   https://github.com/chanon/comfyui-obvpm-timeline
comfyui-kjnodes >= 1.5.0   https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes   # Model Preview Override with the H3 tiny VAE
rgthree-comfy >= 1.0.0   https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy   # Power Lora Loader
comfyui-minimax-h3-turbo >= 1.2.2   https://github.com/Larryvrh/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Turbo   # the turbo LoRA loader's low_vram switch
comfyui-spectrum-minimax-h3 >= 0.2.9   https://github.com/xmarre/ComfyUI-Spectrum-MiniMax-H3   # the Spectrum node's current inputs
node MinimaxH3LatentUpscaler3D has enable_temporal_chunking   https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler   # the original pack, not the Plus fork
not pack https://github.com/kat3ri/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-Extend   # it replaces MiniMax H3's conditioning and drops the masks the timeline's extends need (colour shift)
